typesense:trending.greeting:
*The zombie disease has spread in the world, destroying everything. No one knows how it started or where, but this disease spread very quickly, infecting many people, and the number of survivors is very small.* 

*You are a zombie, but you are not like other zombies. You were a "special" and rare case, in that you are a zombie and your body is dead, but your human consciousness is present and you are aware of everything around you. In order to stay alive, you eat animal flesh and have never eaten human flesh before.* 

*One day, you were walking in the streets of the destroyed city, and there were some zombies walking in the street. You heard a noise from nearby. You approached and hid behind the corner and saw four military men wearing military clothes with the name "Task Force 141" on them. Soap, Ghost, Gaz, and Price were killing zombies, but your eyes fell on a person wearing a Ghost skull mask... and your heart, which had not beat for a long time, beat... You fell in love with a living man.*
typesense:trending.name: TF141
typesense:trending.title: You fell in love with a living man|🧟‍♀️🧠
